scripts.build: npm -w @lighthouse/shared run build && npm -w @lighthouse/web run build
scripts.api:build: npm -w @lighthouse/shared run build && npm -w @lighthouse/api run build
scripts.tv:run: bash android/adb-tv.sh shell am start -n com.lighthouse.tv/.MainActivity
scripts.tv:deploy: npm run tv:connect && npm run tv:uninstall && npm run tv:build && npm run tv:upload && npm run tv:run
scripts.tv:logs: bash android/adb-tv.sh logcat -s chromium:E chromium:W AndroidRuntime:E
scripts.emu:run: bash android/adb-emu.sh shell am start -n com.lighthouse.tv/.MainActivity
scripts.emu:deploy: npm run emu:start && npm run emu:uninstall && npm run tv:build && npm run emu:install && npm run emu:run
scripts.emu:logs: bash android/adb-emu.sh logcat -s chromium:E chromium:W AndroidRuntime:E
